summary: Spec fidelity (F2 Acceptance: no sentence tells the agent to report and stop): the guides still hand the brief to the human and stop. role-planner.md Done-when (l.309-313) says 'the brief is handed to the human and you stop. Nothing else starts before that', and the Excuses row (l.349) says 'The brief is the report; stop' — both contradict step 4-5 (show, ask, record) in the same file. Also canon/skills/SKILL.src.md:91 (loop item 1: 'checks it with canon brief check, and stops for the human'), canon-subject.md:210 ('then stops and reports it'), and the orchestrator next step from status ('human: report the pending draft's brief ... to the human'). Blast radius: a planner that follows Done-when never reaches the ask; the projected stubs and `canon skills show canon|role-planner` carry the same text.
